rows.name: Overview
Objective
Report
Result

The Armu in Gran Dell have become Fogbeasts.
Defeat them before they harm the residents. (Temp.)
Defeat all Armu that have become Fogbeasts. (Temp.)
Damage to Gran Dell was seemingly minimised. (Temp.)

Defeating the Fog King requires a dense ether field.
To obtain a crystal of high ether purity,
ask the townspeople about High Ether Crystals.

Ask the defence force members in Gran Dell
about High Ether Crystals.

Ask the defence force on Gran Dell Ramparts
about High Ether Crystals.

Speak to Sarja
at the Graveyard of Sorrow.
Report to Radam.
Find a [System:Color name=item ]High Ether Crystal[/System:Color].

You gathered information on High Ether Crystals. Finding
one should put you a step closer to beating the Fog King.

You found a High Ether Crystal using the information.
Have Radam modify the Monado Replica.

You gathered promising leads on what might be High
Ether Crystals. Explore the caves near Forbidden
Hushland, where surveys have only just begun.

Go to the caves around the Forbidden Hushland
in search of a [System:Color name=item ]High Ether Crystal[/System:Color].
Obtain a High Ether Crystal. (Temp.)

You obtained a High Ether Crystal.
Have Radam modify the Monado Replica.

Tsukuku apparently dropped his treasured hand
mirror on an islet in Tranquil Tarn. He says
he can't work without it, so help him find it.

Search for [System:Color name=item ]Tsukuku's Mirror[/System:Color] on the small islet
at Tranquil Tarn.

Take [System:Color name=item ]Tsukuku's Mirror[/System:Color] to Tsukuku
by the shore of Tranquil Tarn.

Tsukuku's mirror was found.
Now he can admire his face to his heart's content.

To make up for interrupting Rutoru's survey,
you agreed to help with her request.
Defeat the Spicals.

Defeat 3 Spicals
near Xen's Thoroughfare.
Return to Rutoru.

Speak to Rutoru at the far end
of Xen's Thoroughfare.

The Spicals were defeated and the survey completed.
Rutoru seems relieved to have finished her work.

Sakusaku has finished surveying but apparently
wants to stay and study the local ecology. Beat
her at her riddles and she'll come along, it seems.

Collect an item whose name starts with S
and ends with E.
Give [System:Color name=item ]Sky Mole[/System:Color] to Sakusaku.

Defeat a monster whose name starts with G
and ends with S.
Return to Sakusaku.

You solved Sakusaku's riddles.
As promised, she will come along.

The survey markers keep mysteriously disappearing,
making it impossible to work.
Help Sechichi finish the survey.

Plant [System:Color name=item ]Sechichi's Stake[/System:Color] on the lakeshore
by the side of the Junks.
Return to Sechichi.

Defeat the thief in the higher reaches of
Navvir Highland to recover Sechichi's stolen stake.
Return to Sechichi.

With the stake thief defeated, Sechichi finished her
survey. She seemed to have a weight off her shoulders.

Nanana apparently wants to make a declaration
of resolve on the bridge terrace, but Roguls
are in the way. Defeat the Roguls occupying it.

At Whisperwind Crossing, defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Despotic Rogul[/System:Color]
occupying the terrace.
Return to Nanana.

You defeated the Rogul and witnessed Nanana's declaration.
Nanana will now come along.

Hachocho finished surveying but a monster spotted him
at the last moment, so he dropped his charm while fleeing.
Help Hachocho find his charm.

Look for [System:Color name=item ]Hachocho's Charm[/System:Color]
at Nerthis Necropolis.
Return the charm to Hachocho.

The charm seems to mean more to Hachocho than anything.
Having it back relieved him and restored his composure.

Follow Noino's enigmatic words.
Defeat the monster to provide the "proof".
Defeat "[System:Color name=item ]Thing-a-Majicker XIII[/System:Color]".
Return [System:Color name=item ]Noino's Survey License[/System:Color] to Noino.

The "proof" Noino spoke of
seems to have been a surveyor's licence.

A monster is approaching a Noponjaa.
Rescue them before it attacks.

Defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Slobbering Antol[/System:Color]
approaching the Noponjaa.

Talk to the Noponjaa to make sure
they're OK.

It seems the enemy was drawn in by the
incense. At least Torotoro was all right.

Shiishii finished surveying and was about to have a snack
but apparently dropped it in the pond.
Help her out.

Defeat the shoal of [System:Color name=item ]Whapol Sardi[/System:Color]
that ate the snack Shiishii dropped in the pond.
Return to Shiishii.

Find 3 [System:Color name=item ]Morrow Cobs[/System:Color]
that Shiishii wants to eat.
Deliver the food to Shiishii.

Defeating the monsters seems to have calmed Shiishii.
With her belly full too, she now looks serene.

Wanawana, the captain waiting for the Noponjaa,
forgot to tell the others where to meet.
Bring all the Noponjaa here for him.
Gather the other 11 Noponjaa.
Go and see Wanawana.

Get back the memo from the [System:Color name=item ]Cutpurse Igna
[/System:Color]north of Clear Sky Bluff.
Return the memo to Wanawana.

The Noponjaa assembled and got back the stolen memo.
They seem ready to explain why they came here.

The Noponjaa came here to find a secret treasure.
This is their final request.
Find the secret treasure on Giant God's Shoulder together!

Search for the treasure in the ruins at the back of
Nerthis Necropolis.

Defeat the monster guarding the treasure in the ruins
at the back of Nerthis Necropolis.

Investigate the treasure chest in the ruins at the back
of Nerthis Necropolis.

The Noponjaa found the secret treasure.
Cheers rang out: Ruins Research HQ could remain open.

Exterminate the ether organisms that have spawned
abnormally in two locations on Navvir Highland.
Exterminate the wind elementals.
Exterminate the water elementals.
Return to Treanna.

The two kinds of ether organism have been eliminated.
Monsters should no longer be drawn to their presence.

Gannett asked for help with her research.
Use the prototype General Ether Pick
to mine ether deposits.

Excavate an ether deposit using
the [System:Color name=item ]General Ether Pick[/System:Color].
Return to Gannett.

Gannett provided an Ether Pick, allowing gems to be mined
directly from deposits across the Giant God's Shoulder.

Helmut is short-handed when it comes to gathering
food. Hunt Eks for their Iron Hearts, then
lay Rainbow Carrots as bait for the next hunt.

Defeat Makna Eks at Navvir Highland
and collect 4 [System:Color name=item ]Eks Iron Hearts[/System:Color].

Gather 3 [System:Color name=item ]Rainbow Carrots[/System:Color] to be used
as bait for the Makna Eks.

Head to north-western Navvir Highland and place the
Rainbow Carrots there to lure out the Makna Eks.
Return to Helmut.

Eks Iron Hearts were delivered to Helmut.
Some could be processed and stored for later.

Renato asked for help with three jobs.
Solve the problems in his place.
Complete the quest "Secure Fresh Wildgrass".
Complete the quest "Defeat the Praying Capil".
Complete the quest "Eliminate the Noble Grogs".
Return to Renato.

Future food shortages remain a concern,
but Renato will work out how to address them.

Gianna is struggling to find Fresh Wildgrass.
Help gather some.

Between Navvir Highland and Purifying Falls,
gather 5 sprigs of [System:Color name=item ]Fresh Wildgrass[/System:Color].

Enough was gathered this time.
Capils seem to have eaten it, leaving less to gather.

Praying Capils have appeared in large numbers,
and Fedot cannot defeat them alone.
Help him defeat them.

Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Praying Capils[/System:Color] in the vicinity of
Navvir Crossroads.

The Capils have been defeated.
It seems they gathered to eat the wildgrass.

Noble Grogs have appeared in large numbers,
and Robert cannot defeat them alone.
Help him defeat them.

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Noble Grogs[/System:Color] in the vicinity of
the Purifying Falls.

The Grogs have been successfully dealt with.
It seems they were gathering to hunt Capils.

Gather Pororo's favourite food scattered
across the Giant God's Shoulder and bring it to Pororo.

Search every corner of the Giant God's Shoulder
for [System:Color name=item ]Pororo's Favourites[/System:Color] and give them to Pororo.

Ask Pororo whether all the lost
[System:Color name=item ]Pororo's Favourites[/System:Color] are accounted for.

All of Pororo's favourite food was found and returned.
Now Pororo can visit "that person" without worry.

Help the High Entia woman
being attacked by monsters.

Defeat the Antols
to rescue the woman under attack.
Make sure the woman is OK.

You defeated the monsters and rescued Leafa.
The Armu keeper returned safely to Gran Dell.

The Rusty ID Tag belonged to Laban's older brother.
He wants the bangle his brother wore with it
to be found as well.

Search for the bangle on the high ground
at Shoulderstone Scree.
Give the [System:Color name=item ]Warped Bangle[/System:Color] to Laban.

You found Laban's older brother's bangle.
Laban will keep it as an heirloom.

Shuushuu climbed a tree to escape a monster,
but let her guard down, fell and got hurt.
Help Shuushuu.

Gather a [System:Color name=item ]Peppity Herb[/System:Color] from atop the
Cragmaw Caverns.
Give the [System:Color name=item ]Peppity Herb[/System:Color] to Shuushuu.

Defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Revenant Volff[/System:Color]
targeting Shuushuu.
Return to Shuushuu.

Thanks to Nene, Shuushuu isn't afraid to climb trees.
She seems set to avoid it for a while, though.

In return for finding a catalyst for him to use in his
tool upgrades, Lott offers to improve your Ether Pick.
Find him a Cerulean Shard in Barouh Ruins Cave.

Look for a [System:Color name=item ]Cerulean Shard[/System:Color] around
Barouh Ruins Cave.

Give Lott
the [System:Color name=item ]Cerulean Shard[/System:Color].

With your new Reinforced Ether Pick, you'll be able to
find better gems from ether deposits than before.

Melekanze is studying monsters on the Giant
God's Shoulder but seems to be having
trouble. Take photographs for her.

Take a photo of a [System:Color name=item ]Glow Deinos[/System:Color] in the
Forbidden Hushland during the night.

Take a photo of a [System:Color name=item ]Dozy Eluca[/System:Color] at the plateau
near the Purifying Falls during the day.
Return to Melekanze.

Melekanze was delighted to see the photographs.
But what she truly longs to study is[XENO:line ]

The Paguurs in the lake where Junks crashed seem to have
turned violent. It's unsafe to gather food there.
Defeat the Paguurs in the area as requested.

Around the lake where Junks crashed,
defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Clamouring Paguurs[/System:Color].
Return to Mithril.

You defeated the Paguurs and peace returned to the lake.
Hopefully the fish can now be delivered safely.

Margo's elderly Machina benefactor apparently
can't move because of a fault in his leg.
Fetch a General Medical Kit from Junks.

Head to Junks
and obtain a [System:Color name=item ]General Medical Kit[/System:Color].

Head to Nerthis Necropolis
and look for Hersel.

Persuade Hersel
to hand over the [System:Color name=item ]General Medical Kit[/System:Color].
Give the [System:Color name=item ]General Medical Kit[/System:Color] to Margo.

The General Medical Kit was delivered to Margo.
The elderly Machina should now be able to move.

Ancient Gran Dell is strewn with rubble.
Hover Stones should let you levitate it
and carry it away. Gather some Hover Stones.

Collect 3 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Hover Stone[/System:Color] at Soltnar
Seal Island, Pillar Knoll and Scapular Lance.
Give the [System:Color name=item ]Hover Stone[/System:Color] to Selsetana.

The rubble was cleared and Gran Dell is clean.
Those who lived here long ago would surely be glad.

Nestor, Sele and the others found no flowers to offer
at a grave in Gran Dell, it seems. Look for them
for Nestor, as it's unsafe outside the walls.

Near Lamentation Pass,
gather 3 [System:Color name=item ]Dawn Flowers[/System:Color].
Hand the [System:Color name=item ]Dawn Flowers[/System:Color] over to Nestor.

You found the Dawn Flowers.
Nestor left them at the grave and prayed fervently.

An airship in Achamoth may have parts
that could be used to repair Junks.
Head there to retrieve them.

Investigate the airship in the vicinity of
Achamoth's Main Entrance.

Investigate the airship in the vicinity of
Melfica Road.

Examine the airship
on the outer perimeter of the second floor.
Return to Hermina.

Despite encountering Telethia, some parts were recovered.
More parts will probably be needed to repair Junks.

Arara, a Nopon from Frontier Village, asked the group
to repay Hero Riki's debt in his place.
Find ingredients for Giant Prilim and a cook to make it.

Search each region of the Giant God's Shoulder
for 7 [System:Color name=item ]Kilopumpkins[/System:Color].

Find a [System:Color name=item ]Sweet Cherry[/System:Color] along the banks of the
Tranquil Tarn.

Ask Tasheen in Gran Dell
to prepare the Prilim.

Talk to Arara and let him know that preparations
for making the Giant Prilim are complete.

The fine Giant Prilim and their hard work moved Arara.
They repaid the debt and earned his heartfelt thanks.

Ines apparently ran out of the growth
stimulant for her wheat field. Gather
the ingredients she needs to make more.
Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]High Leaves[/System:Color].

Defeat Skeets near Xen's Thoroughfare and
gather 4 globs of [System:Color name=item ]Skeet Thick Nectar[/System:Color] (clear weather only).
Report to Ines.

Ines seems set on increasing her wheat harvest.
<More collectible spots at Halcyon Wheats>

Bartol asked Alfreda to make a tool for catching fish,
but she's short on the materials she needs.
Gather the materials for her.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Snare Wires[/System:Color]
and 3 [System:Color name=item ]Half Parts[/System:Color].
Collect the remaining [System:Color name=item ]Half Parts[/System:Color].
Give the materials you collected to Alfreda.
Collect the remaining [System:Color name=item ]Snare Wires[/System:Color].

Find Bartol near Tranquil Tarn and give him
the "Easy! Fish-Catcher-kun".

Bartol taught you how to use "Easy! Fish-Catcher-kun".
<More collectible spots at Tranquil Tarn>

Gather Glutton Herbs to finish the nutritionally
complete "Radam Meshin EX".
Gather 3 [System:Color name=item ]Glutton Herbs[/System:Color].
Report to Radam.

Radam Meshin EX was completed successfully.
Never mind the name; its taste seems quite popular.

Kino approached Angela, a girl playing by herself,
and found that she's shy around strangers too.
Angela looks lonely. Help her make some friends.
Talk to Sele where the imperial capital is visible.
Talk to Nestor near Tranquil Tarn.
Talk to Rudolph near the ruins of Gran Dell.
Report to Angela.

Kino helped Angela make new friends.
Thanks to him, she now has four friends including Kino.

Angela wants something matching with her new friends.
Kino promised to make Best Friend Bracelets,
a Nopon tradition. Gather the materials to make them.

In the woods along Thulles Way,
obtain 5 lengths of [System:Color name=item ]Elastic Ivy[/System:Color].
Report to Angela.

By the rocks near the lake where Junks crashed,
obtain 5 [System:Color name=item ]Sparkle Stones[/System:Color].
Report to Angela.

Everyone was overjoyed at Kino's bracelets.
Wearing matching ones may bring them even closer.

Amleto is worried that Winia seems down.
To cheer her up,
he asked you to find someone who can make a ring.
Find someone who can make a ring.

In the rocky area deep in Forbidden Hushland,
obtain a [System:Color name=item ]Bright Stone[/System:Color].
Give the [System:Color name=item ]Bright Stone[/System:Color] to Kurt.

Give Amleto
the ring made by Kurt.

Kurt made the ring that Amleto requested.
Amleto seems pleased with it.

Amleto and Kurt headed to Zekr Marga Quarry.
Go and look for them.

Find Amleto
at Zekr Marga Quarry.

Find Kurt
at Zekr Marga Quarry.
Talk to Winia and let her know both men are all right.

You brought Amleto and Kurt back.
This incident made Winia reconsider how she lives.

Tasheen is making a home-cooked meal for Talco.
Bring him the three ingredients.
Gather 3 bunches of [System:Color name=item ]Cream Wheat[/System:Color].
Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Monsieur Clams[/System:Color].
Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Angel Bream[/System:Color].
Bring the ingredients to Tasheen.

You delivered the ingredients to Tasheen.
Now let's hope he stays safe.[XENO:line ]

The sender of the letter is waiting for Melia.
Head to Companions' Cape.
Go to Companions' Cape.
Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Resentful Gelgar[/System:Color].
Talk to Gelgar.

After the battle,
Melia and the others witnessed Gelgar's final moments.

Some residents have reportedly been acting
oddly lately. A Nopon seems to know what's
going on. Talk to them on Maxis's behalf.
Ask Pororo what's going on.

Report to Maxis
about the "Mystery Drink".

Catch Bahn,
who headed towards Halcyon Wheats.

Defeat Bahn,
who is lying in wait at Halcyon Wheats.

Talk to Bahn,
who's hanging his head at Halcyon Wheats.

Melia and the others thwarted Bahn's grand ambitions.
And once again, Bahn found himself being punished.
